pronunciation.approximation: Say "metztli" with the stress and length implied by the scholarly restoration "Metztli".
pronunciation.note: The ASCII form "metztli" is a DNS compromise; the restoration "Metztli" preserves the name's scholarly dignity.

domains.title: Metztli
domains.subtitle: Moon
domains.lead: Metztli is moon. The name means "Moon" and belongs to the nahuatl tradition.

cards.name: Sacred Name
cards.desc: The restoration Metztli returns the figure to scholarly recognition.

cards.name: Living Tradition
cards.desc: Honored in nahuatl myth, cult, and cultural memory.

cards.name: Unicode Restoration
cards.desc: Preserved as a flagship temple despite the unregistrable plain-ASCII form.

symbols.name: Name
symbols.meaning: The restored form Metztli, carrying scholarly and cultural weight.

mythology.lead: The stories of Metztli place moon at the center of a living mythological world.

myths.title: Origins
myths.text: Metztli appears in nahuatl tradition as moon. The name's meaning, "Moon", shapes the narratives told about this figure.

myths.title: Worship and Memory
myths.text: Devotees and later tradition-keepers preserved Metztli in ritual, text, and iconography, ensuring the name survived into the modern scholarly record.

lore.culturalLegacy: Metztli remains a touchstone for understanding nahuatl religion, art, and identity.
